data.long_meaning: Dhrasika is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhras’ which means ‘shining’, ‘radiant’ or ‘sparkling’. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl in Hindu culture. The name Dhrasika carries the meaning “Shining, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhrasika usually hope their child will grow to embody shining, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
